head: Duo Holy Bible app opens like a printed book on the iPhone Duo
dek: Duo Holy Bible is a new $4.99 King James Bible app built for the folding iPhone Duo: unfold the phone and the book opens to a two-page spread, fold it and the book closes. It was #52 in paid Reference apps on the US App Store on 15 November.
details: It holds all 1,189 chapters of the King James Version, and an update added Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian and Dutch translations. You can type a reference like John 3:16 to jump to it, bookmark pages, highlight verses in four colours and share a verse with its reference. The whole text is on the phone, so it reads offline, with no account, ads or analytics. It's made by Michael Berk.
where: iPhone (made for iPhone Duo), App Store, $4.99
means: If you read the Bible on your iPhone Duo, this one uses the folding screen to look and turn like a paper book.
todo: Look it up on the App Store; it's a one-time $4.99 purchase.
thumb_words: A BIBLE THAT OPENS WITH YOUR PHONE
